summary: Rain Enhancement Technologies Holdco (RAIN) filed an 8-K disclosing a binding LOI, dated September 18, 2026, to combine with privately held predictive-AI developer Tensor Networks and affiliated with Chairman Harry You, a greater-than-10% holder. The contemplated all-stock deal would leave Tensor Networks equityholders with roughly 90% of the fully diluted combined company and RAIN holders about 10%, prior to a planned PIPE. Both boards unanimously approved. Closing requires due diligence, definitive agreement, RAIN shareholder approval, Nasdaq continued-listing grant and initial listing approval. Deal terms, valuation and timing remain unfixed, so closing risk is elevated.
